name: Swiss School of Business Management

about.text: Swiss School of Business & Management (SSBM) is one of the highly committed universities continuously trying to provide academic excellence to individuals in the field of business & management. The innovative & tech-driven educational services provided by the universities are aimed at equipping management aspirants with research-oriented & premium education. With more than 30 international industry partners, the university is imparting high-quality knowledge even to international candidates.

SSBM is located at the heart of a business city in Switzerland, i.e., Geneva. Being a global financial and diplomacy center, Geneva is filled with numerous international organizations, including the headquarters of many high-profile companies and international agencies. The advantage of being surrounded by the industry gives you exposure to the diversity of the management field.

facts: SSBM is a university situated in the city of Geneva, Switzerland.
The university is offering academic excellence via online & on-campus modes of learning.
The university is offering a diversified range of online courses in the business & management field under UG, PG, & doctoral programs.

Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Business Administration, International Management, Information Technology, Sports Management, & Accelerated Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Business Administration are some of the UG programs offered at SSBM.

The list of SSBM’s PG programs includes a Master in Global Business and International Master in Sports Law, Global MBA, EMBA, MBA in Data Science, Finance, Hospitality Management, & many other MBA specializations.

The university has also enlightened doctoral aspirants via its popular Doctorate in Business Administration (DBA) program. Some of the options available in this category include Executive DBA, Global DBA, & International DBA.
The credibility of SSBM’s courses has been approved & accredited by some of the elite accreditation bodies like ACBSP, AACSB, & EduQua.
The premium knowledge delivered by the university has been recognized globally with a rating of 5 QS Stars & with the authorization of the OTHM center.
SSBM was listed in the top 10 European Universities For Online Study at PostGrad.com.
The university‘s faculty panel comes from top universities around the world & delivers quality education in new & interesting ways.
Students at SSBM are assessed based on the European Credit Transfer and Accumulation System, i.e., the ECTS credit system.
The university’s sustainable approach promotes businesses that place the planet, people, and employees before their profit.

emi.text: Swiss School of Business & Management provides flexible modes of payment for its online programs that make it even more approachable for learners. The financial support of the university in terms of Equated Monthly Installment (EMI) payment options offers you a chance to acquire knowledge from world-class faculty members.

In the need of making quality education accessible for all, the university has even proposed some scholarships for the candidates based on their academic performance. The terms & conditions for the same may vary as the guidelines for it are revised every year. Moreover, students can avail of some fee relaxations on payment of the total tuition fee at once.

admission.text: The process of admission to online undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctorate programs at SSBM can be completed via digitized mode. The following steps outline the common admission process at the university:

Step 1 At first, go through the list of documents you need to prepare before starting the enrollment process. This list generally includes your professional resume, ID proofs, photograph, & latest grade transcripts.
Step 2 After that register on the university’s website by filling out your basic contact information to apply for your particular course.
Step 3 Access the SSBM Student Application System (SAS) & fill out your personal, educational, & professional details. Submit the documents asked by the university on the same panel.
Step 4 At last complete your application by choosing a suitable payment method & the number of installments, if applicable.
Step 5 After the application submission, the university will notify you of its decision by sending an interview invitation.
Step 6 After making it through the interview, you will get an offer letter from the university. The offer letter will confirm any scholarships or financial assistance you asked for.
Step 7 After receiving an offer letter, you need to pay a blocking amount of the tuition fee to ensure your admission.

In case the applicant doesn’t belong to a majority English-speaking country, the university asks for an English language competency test. These tests include either TOEFL, IELTS, or Cambridge tests. An intensive English Program certificate or an official certificate from an English-speaking or Bilingual school will also work as proof of English language proficiency.

faqs.q: What are MBA specializations offered by the Swiss School of Business & Management in online mode?
faqs.a: SSBM University provides online MBA in a variety of specializations like Data Science, Finance, Cybersecurity Management, Human Resources Management, Global Finance and Banking, Marketing, Operations Management, Strategic Management, Entrepreneurship, IT Management, and Sustainability & Energy Management.

faqs.q: Are the degrees from the Swiss School of Business & Management recognized in India?
faqs.a: SSBM University has been accredited by ACBSP and holds a 5-star QS rating that makes its courses well-recognized internationally including India. Moreover, its AACSB membership makes it a part of the global leader’s network.

faqs.q: Is there any entrance exam for enrolling into SSBM’s online program?
faqs.a: The demand for entrance exams is program specific at the Swiss School of Business & Management. However, the university does ask for scores on English Language Proficiency Tests like TOEFL, IELTS, etc.

faqs.q: Is any scholarship or financial assistance provided by the Swiss School of Business & Management?
faqs.a: SSBM offers scholarships to aspiring candidates based on their academic performance & depending on the program they are applying to. Moreover, easy EMI options or flexible payment methods are there for all to provide financial assistance.

faqs.q: Who are the faculty members at the Swiss School of Business & Management?
faqs.a: The faculty members at SSBM are experts holding 15+ years of industry experience & professors teaching at top-ranked International Universities. These experts form a direct impact on learners & prepare them for the challenges of today’s fast-changing world.
